priority_semantics: Relative investigation priority within the frozen pilot AOI; not a calibrated heat-risk probability.

fields.heat_score: median percentile rank across validated Landsat daytime dates
fields.greening_need: built fraction among reliable terrestrial built+vegetation pixels
fields.heat_scene_count: number of moderate core dates supporting this cell
fields.hot_recurrence: fraction of supported dates where cell is in hottest quartile
fields.heat_rank_iqr: temporal dispersion of heat percentile rank
